# United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)

> > The United Nations Development Programme is the UN's global development network, working in over 170 countries to eradicate poverty, reduce inequalities, and build resilience through sustainable development.

UNDP operates country offices worldwide supporting climate action, democratic governance, peacebuilding, and poverty reduction aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals. The organization provides technical assistance, policy advice, and capacity building while publishing Human Development Reports and coordinating programs like the Junior Professional Officer Programme and Prevention of Violent Extremism initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
- Climate change and climate action
- Poverty reduction and human development
- Biodiversity and ecosystem restoration
- Democratic governance and anti-corruption
- Peacebuilding and conflict prevention
- Green economy and decarbonization
- Energy access and renewable energy (SDG7)
- Gender equality and social inclusion
- Digital transformation and inclusion
- Disaster risk reduction and resilience
- Blue economy and ocean conservation
- Prevention of Violent Extremism (PVE)
- Human Development Reports
- Country office programming

## Country Offices and Regional Programs

- [Узбекистан | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/ru/uzbekistan): UNDP Uzbekistan country office: climate, green economy, biodiversity work
- [México | Programa De Las Naciones Unidas Para El Desarrollo](https://www.undp.org/es/mexico): UNDP Mexico country office: sustainable development, climate, biodiversity
- [Mauritanie | Programme des Nations Unies pour le développement](https://www.undp.org/fr/mauritania): UNDP Mauritania: rural electrification, solar energy, sustainable development
- [Suomi | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/fi/finland): UNDP Finland country page: poverty reduction, climate, gender equality
- [Cook Islands, Niue, Samoa and Tokelau | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/samoa): UNDP Pacific Islands office: climate change, blue economy, green energy

## Governance, Peace, and Security

- [Prevention of Violent Extremism (PVE) | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/prevent-violent-extremism): PVE programs: conflict prevention, peacebuilding, community resilience focus
- [Oficina Independiente de Evaluación | Programa De Las Naciones Unidas Para El Desarrollo](https://www.undp.org/es/evaluation): Independent Evaluation Office: accountability and rigorous UNDP assessments
- [The quest for cities of peace | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/blog/quest-cities-peace): Urban violence prevention through local governance and SDG 11/16 alignment
- [An important opportunity to shape the global anti-corruption agenda | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/blog/important-opportunity-shape-global-anti-corruption-agenda): UN anti-corruption agenda, transparency, and COVID-19 governance impacts

## Climate Action and Environment

- [Climate Change and the Rise of Poverty | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/blog/climate-change-and-rise-poverty): Climate change impacts on poverty and adaptive social protection strategies
- [Putting people at the centre of the energy revolution | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/blog/putting-people-centre-energy-revolution): SDG7 energy access, renewable energy transition, and climate action focus
- [World Environment Day - Recreate. Reimagine. Restore | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/blog/world-environment-day-recreate-reimagine-restore): World Environment Day: UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration and Equator Prize
- [The only way to reduce risk is to understand it | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/blog/only-way-reduce-risk-understand-it): Disaster risk reduction, climate hazards, and Rwanda's National Risk Atlas
- [Adopting a cedar tree brings diaspora money home | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/blog/adopting-cedar-tree-brings-diaspora-money-home): Lebanon cedar reforestation via diaspora financing and blockchain innovation

## Human Development and Poverty Reduction

- [Informe de Desarrollo Humano | Programa De Las Naciones Unidas Para El Desarrollo](https://www.undp.org/es/honduras/idh): Honduras Human Development Report: democracy, rule of law, social change

## Careers and Opportunities

- [JPO Service Centre | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/jposc): Junior Professional Officer Programme for young UN development careers

## Optional

- [In eastern Ukraine, a platform for recovery | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/blog/eastern-ukraine-platform-recovery): Eastern Ukraine recovery efforts addressing displacement and infrastructure
- [Will digital be a force for good? It's up to us to decide | United Nations Development Programme](https://www.undp.org/blog/will-digital-be-force-good-its-us-decide): Digital transformation, inclusion challenges, and bridging the digital divide
